decisions.proposedTreatmentOrFormula: CGI arts 81–82 require withholding at payment and remittance by the 15th of the following month. Art 74 bis(5) requires the preceding-calendar-year pay/withholding statement by 15 March. The 2026 art 74 bis(1) has category-specific annual taxpayer filing dates: 31 July for specified high personalities/public/parapublic employees, 30 September for private employees of DGE/CIME/CSI taxpayers, 31 October for other individuals. The 2024 circular’s June date must not be copied as the 2026 rule. Keep these obligations separate from the internal calculation/posting/release sequence.

engineeringSelections.selection: Unknown is not zero. Supported YTD evaluation requires both explicit prior base and prior withheld amounts; each named adjustment requires an own, explicit, finite value. Current base and monetary rule values reject NaN/Infinity. Explicit zero remains valid. The fixture adapter preserves absent history instead of defaulting to zero.

engineeringSelections.selection: For an owning Prisma client, calculation uses the existing payroll transition helper: SERIALIZABLE transaction, at most three attempts for P2034/P2002, re-query idempotency on every attempt, return 409 after exhaustion, do not retry domain errors, redact unexpected internal errors. No external side effect is added to the retry callback. Current production caller audit: actions/payroll/payroll-control.actions.ts and prisma/disposable-business-workflows.ts both call calculatePayrollRun without an injected client, so both use the owning-client SERIALIZABLE/retry boundary. No additional production caller change is needed in this checkout. Future injected TransactionClient callers must establish isolation/retry explicitly; mocked callers are not database proof.
engineeringSelections.limit: An injected TransactionClient inherits its caller transaction; caller owns isolation and retry. Same-day statutory membership, stale-history checks at approval/posting, real contention/rollback and uncertain-commit proof remain pending. This is not full ENG-04 completion.
